header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Bhooro Bheel advocate holding brief on behalf of Mr. Satram
Sonani Bheel advocate for the petitioner
Mr. Ghulamullah Memon, A.A.G a/w Dawar Ali Khan, Senior
body: Auditor, District Accounts Office, Sanghar and Syed Hussain Ali Shah, Focal Person (Litigation) Additional Director TTI Sindh, Hyderabad.

This petition was filed with the prayer for issuing directions to respondents to release the arrears of salaries of the petitioner. After notices, statement has been filed by respondent No.2 & 5. Today, Syed Hussain Ali Shah, Focal Person (Litigation) Additional Director Teacher Training Institutions Sindh, Hyderabad is present and submits that the case of petitioner in respect of the arrears has been forwarded to the Finance Department. Whereas, representative of District Accounts Officer, Sanghar submits that whenever he received the bill of arrears he shall released the same to the petitioner.

In view of the above, this petition is disposed of with directions to the respondents to complete the entire process for releasing the arrears of the petitioner within 30 days and release the same in accordance with law. JUDGE JUDGE Salik
